# A balance stated on a split that spends USD rather than bringing any in.
#
# Every question the import asks of a stated balance is satisfied: the account
# is kept in a currency other than the book's own, the figure parses, it is
# positive, it fits the cent, and it is no more than the 0.72 the split
# carries. What it is not is a cost basis — the split lowers this account's
# USD — so nothing will ever read the figure.
#
# Lowering it is a disposal, so the same split says which cost basis the 0.72
# came out of: the 2,720.00 USD deposit, whose split
# `fx_usd_deposit_against_due_from_director.txt` gives a guid of its own. The
# two keys are about different things and both belong here — one says what this
# split brought in, which is nothing, and the other says what it spent.

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Non-farming expenses – Operating expenses:Bank charges 1.01 CAD
	Assets:Current assets:Cash and deposits:Deposits in Canadian banks and institutions – Foreign currency:Foreign Payments Provider Chequing 000000000000001 -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.4029"
		value: "-1.01"
		cost_basis_balance: "0.72"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "00e958a8d56547d484d7629000292dc3"
